rationale: The formal-claim vocabulary: definition, theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, conjecture and proof, each of whose assertion is a mathematical claim a .lean sibling can check. A folio of the paper profile uses these beside folio-assistant-core's `document` kinds. Owner, 2026-10-12 (bean bzwk, option B): one adapter per layer, several per folio. It was `paper` until then, covering core's kinds as well, which made the platform's vocabulary depend on this layer being mounted. The name changed; the profile (`paper`) and the server adapter CLASS (contentType `paper`) did not.
